description: MCP server for AI image generation via OpenAI, Stable Diffusion (SD WebUI), or placeholders.
name: io.github.pvliesdonk/image-generation-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of the deployed server, e.g. `https://mcp.example.com`. Required for OIDC. Also the fallback source of the MCP Apps domain when `app_domain` is unset.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Single shared bearer token; enables bearer auth unless `bearer_tokens_file` is set, which takes precedence.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OIDC discovery document URL, e.g. `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CONFIG_URL

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client identifier registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OIDC client secret registered with the provider.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Expected `aud` claim; tokens issued for another audience are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE

environmentVariables.description: Scopes a caller must present, space- or comma-separated. Defaults to `openid` in oidc-proxy mode.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_REQUIRED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Scopes advertised to MCP clients in protected-resource metadata, space- or comma-separated. Overrides the default `openid offline_access`; `oidc_required_scopes` is always added on top. Set this when the registered client is not permitted `offline_access`, or to have clients request extra claim scopes (e.g. `groups`) without also requiring them in every token.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_ADVERTISED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Signing key for issued JWTs; used in oidc-proxy mode only. When unset, the key is derived deterministically from `oidc_client_secret`, so tokens survive a restart — but rotating that secret invalidates every issued token. Set this explicitly to decouple token validity from secret rotation. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Validate the access token instead of the id token.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OIDC_VERIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_KV_STORE_URL

environmentVariables.description: MCP Apps iframe domain, used for CSP sandboxing. Overrides the host derived from `base_url`.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_APP_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Explicit auth-mode override, accepting `remote` or `oidc-proxy` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). When unset the mode is auto-detected from which auth variables are set; the override exists because having all four OIDC variables set is ambiguous between those two modes. Other values are ignored with a warning.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a TOML file mapping bearer tokens to subjects; overrides the single-token `bearer_token` mode.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BEARER_TOKENS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Subject assigned to the single-token bearer mode; ignored when `bearer_tokens_file` is set, since mapped mode carries per-token subjects.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_BEARER_DEFAULT_SUBJECT

environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SERVER_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Mount path for the MCP endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this UID; the container entrypoint chowns writable paths to match.
environmentVariables.name: PUID

environmentVariables.description: Run the server process as this GID; pair with PUID to match the owner of a mounted volume.
environmentVariables.name: PGID

environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.
environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING

environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST; logs a warning when used.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL; logs a warning when used.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: When true, write-tagged tools (image generation, transforms, uploads) are hidden from clients. Set false to enable them.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated images are saved. Created automatically on first use.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SCRATCH_DIR

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, dall-e-3) when set.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Google API key. Enables the Gemini provider (gemini-3.1-flash-image and others) when set. Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_GOOGLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: SD WebUI base URL (such as http://localhost:7860). Enables the SD WebUI provider when set. Compatible with AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, reForge, and Forge-neo.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST

environmentVariables.description: SD WebUI checkpoint name, used for model-aware preset detection (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Lightning) and checkpoint override. Unset uses the instance's current model.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Provider used when no keyword triggers auto-selection: auto, openai, gemini, sd_webui, or placeholder. auto picks the first configured provider.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_DEFAULT_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of transformed image results (resize, crop, convert) kept in memory. Set 0 to disable caching.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFORM_CACHE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated provider names that cost money; generate_image asks for confirmation (client elicitation) before using them. An empty value falls back to this default; to disable confirmation, set a value that names no provider (such as none).
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_PAID_PROVIDERS

environmentVariables.description: Directory for style preset files (Markdown with YAML front matter). Created automatically if it does not exist.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_STYLES_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Allow reading input images from local filesystem paths. Off by default: only URLs and uploads are accepted.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILE_INPUT

environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_MAX_INPUT_IMAGE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S

environmentVariables.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S

environmentVariables.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S

environmentVariables.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S

environmentVariables.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.
environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

title: Image Generation MCP Server
